content.short: Solidity Fuzzing Boilerplate provides fuzzing templates for smart contracts.
content.description: Solidity Fuzzing Boilerplate is a contract-testing template repository that includes ready-made fuzzing templates for Solidity smart contracts, designed to work with multiple fuzzing tools such as Echidna and Foundry. It lets you author tests once and run them under both tools, streamlining cross-tool fuzzing workflows. By deploying contracts to Ganache, you can fuzz components that rely on Solidity versions that may be incompatible. The goal is to ease the fuzzing of Solidity projects and libraries.
